Maya (PM): Quick heads-up: three pilot customers are blocking on tenant-scoped routing + audit logs. Sales wants a pilot-ready path next sprint. Thoughts?

Emily (Eng): Fast option: config-driven routing shim (tenant -> route) stored in config service. Shipable in ~1 sprint as a feature-flagged layer. No UI or rollout controls.

Raj (GTM): Customers need to route certain tenants to private models or higher-tier pools. Without something pilots slip.

Sam (Sales): Acme & Beacon said theyll sign pilots if we provide tenant controls and logs. They asked explicitly for a pilot solution, not full productization.

Lena (Research): Long-term: rule-based policy engine with rollout and TTLs. Thats 6-8 weeks and we need perf/caching evals.

Chris (Data): Gating metrics we need: 95th pct latency delta, per-tenant cost delta, audit-log completeness. Define thresholds before rollout.

Maya (PM): Proposal to present: A) Pilot shim (config routing + 90d logs), B) Policy engine MVP, C) Managed dedicated pilot.

Emily (Eng): Tradeoffs: A = quick, 2 devs 10 days + oncall. B = 4 devs 6-8 weeks. C = ops/infra commitments. We can make A forward-compatible with B if we keep the config schema stable.

Sam (Sales): Acme will accept A if we include migration/deprecation plan + paid support SLA. Beacon prefers C but could accept A.

Maya (PM): Launch criteria for A: routing verified in canary; 95th pct latency <= +12%; audit logs include request_id, tenant_id, resolved_route and retained 90 days; sales/legal pilot doc signed.

Chris (Data): Ill prepare a smoke eval capturing throughput, tail latency, cache hit rates per tenant, and cost delta. Need exact log field names from eng.

Emily (Eng): Will implement config namespace so policy engine can override later. Add rollout window and rollback steps.

Maya (PM): Quick vote - :+1: for A, :thinking_face: for B, :handshake: for C.

Emily (Eng): :+1: A (with migration path).

Sam (Sales): :+1: A.

Raj (GTM): :+1: A urgent.

Lena (Research): :thinking_face: prefer B long-term but ok for A as stopgap.

Chris (Data): :+1: with instrumentation.

Maya (PM): Consensus: ship A into next sprint as a pilot shim. Action items: Maya - spec & runbook by EOD; Emily - 2d spike on config propagation; Chris - smoke eval fields; Sam - pilot commitment language.

deploy-bot: JIRA PLAT-2378 created: "Tenant routing pilot shim - spec & rollout"

Raj (GTM): Ill present this in pilot sync Friday. Any blockers, flag here.

Maya (PM): If no objections in 24h well slot it into sprint planning. :rocket:
